disclaimer: Regions denote computational roles inspired by neuroscience naming in REE. Coverage reflects claims, substrate code, and experiment evidence -- not biological completeness or anatomical accuracy. The three planes are orthogonal slices of one co-registered MNI152 template volume, arranged as an orthographic projection sheet: coronal (front, y=-18) above axial (top, z=+6) sharing the left-right axis, sagittal (side, x=0) beside coronal sharing the superior-inferior axis -- so a region lines up across views and can be traced. Each region is placed once in MNI space and projected into every plane it appears in. Region placement follows the founder layout intent (E1=cerebrum, E2=cerebellum, E3=BG commitment) documented in founder_ontology.md and is still being refined.

regions.notes: Rollouts, path memory, terrain / residue navigation.

claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.path_memory

claims_sample.title: Hippocampus generates explicit rollouts and post-commitment viability mapping.

claims_sample.title: HippocampalModule navigates z_self trajectory space (deliberation sequences) in addition to z_world action-object space O, enabling the agent to plan its own deliberation.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampal.z_self_trajectory_navigation

claims_sample.title: Hippocampal terrain maps encode separable valence dimensions (wanting, liking, harm-discriminative, surprise); ARC-007 residue-field navigation is the harm-causal special case of this general architecture.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.multidimensional_valence_map

claims_sample.title: During waking immobility, hippocampal replay switches between task-focused forward sweeps (planning mode) and local consolidation replay (integration mode) based on task demand; this waking consolidation mode is architecturally necessary for viability map integration during experience.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.waking_consolidation_mode

claims_sample.title: Durable long-term storage of the hippocampal viability map requires a hippocampal-entorhinal loop that engages during offline (sleep/DMN-equivalent) consolidation and provides a coordinate-invariant grid representation; this loop does not operate during waking planning or waking immobility consolidation.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.entorhinal_offline_consolidation

claims_sample.title: The REE hippocampal module requires dorsal-predominant trajectory proposal (value-free spatial navigation) combined with a ventral-analog valence prior sourced from R(x,t) geometry; these are architecturally segregated, not merged.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.dorsal_ventral_functional_segregation

claims_sample.title: Bidirectional hippocampus-neocortex information flow is architecturally necessary for attribution mapping convergence: the SWS-direction (hippocampus to cortex) installs context schema structure; waking and REM-direction reactivations fill those structures with causal attribution estimates. Without bidirectional flow, context representations remain globally undifferentiated despite locally coherent online encoding.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.bidirectional_information_flow

claims_sample.title: Approach behavior toward reward locations emerges from the interaction of DA-mediated representational expansion (MECH-232) and an information-seeking (curiosity) drive operating on the hippocampal map. No explicit approach gradient or wanting field is required in hippocampal terrain.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.curiosity_approach_emergence

claims_sample.title: Schema-primed rapid assimilation: any hippocampal planning system with a stable prior map must gate episode consolidation rate by map stability -- new episodes entering a mature, coherent residue field should consolidate without the full multi-episode warmup required for a sparse or unstable map.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.schema_primed_rapid_consolidation

claims_sample.title: Hippocampal systems inject hypotheses gated by control plane.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampal.hypothesis_injection

claims_sample.title: E2 forward-prediction kernels seed hippocampal rollouts.
claims_sample.subject: hippocampus.kernel_chaining_interface

regions.label: Prefrontal cortex
regions.notes: Lateral PFC, OFC, frontopolar analogs; vmPFC partly distributed.

claims_sample.title: vmPFC is the substrate that converts stored affective, normative, and residue content -- prior outcome history, social and identity constraints, learned value associations, and safety memories -- into active components of the navigable state used by E3 during trajectory evaluation.
claims_sample.subject: vmPFC.affective_normative_state_preparation

claims_sample.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate stored aversive residue as an anticipatory forward-biasing signal in the navigable state at trajectory evaluation time; residue that is correctly stored but not so activated will fail to suppress harm-associated trajectory re-selection.
claims_sample.subject: vmPFC.residue_activation

claims_sample.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate social and identity constraints as live trajectory gates in the navigable state; constraints that are stored as semantic knowledge but not so activated will not prevent norm-violating trajectory generation even when post-hoc evaluation correctly identifies the violation.
claims_sample.subject: vmPFC.constraint_activation

claims_sample.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate safety memories with sufficient force to compete with threat-attractor states at the level of navigable state construction; an extinction memory that exists in storage but cannot outcompete the threat attractor at state-construction time will produce intrusive return to threat-consistent trajectory generation regardless of contextual safety evidence.
claims_sample.subject: vmPFC.safety_memory_competition

claims_sample.title: A vmPFC-analog substrate must activate goal approach pull as a distinct property from goal representation; a goal that is correctly represented (G component present) but whose approach pull is not activated produces avoidance and anhedonia indistinguishable from absent goals, but is correctable by restoring approach-pull activation without changing goal content.
claims_sample.subject: vmPFC.goal_approach_pull_activation

claims_sample.title: Rule-selective persistence in lateral-PFC-analog: stimulus-abstracted rule representations in SD-033a persist across simulated time steps without external drive, remain selective through distractor events, and emerge through training rather than being innate.
claims_sample.subject: pfc.lateral_pfc_rule_selective_persistence

claims_sample.title: OFC-analog state-space and specific-outcome representation: SD-033b represents both a structured cognitive map of the current task state space and the specific outcomes expected from actions in each state. Value signals ride on top of this structured representation rather than being stored in it directly.
claims_sample.subject: pfc.ofc_state_space_specific_outcome

claims_sample.title: Frontopolar counterfactual-value tracking: SD-033e maintains, in parallel with SD-033c's chosen-option value signal, a running estimate of the value of unchosen alternatives. A switch-to-alternative decision is signalled when the counterfactual estimate exceeds the chosen estimate by a threshold-sensitive margin.
claims_sample.subject: pfc.frontopolar_counterfactual_value_tracking

claims_sample.title: Frontopolar relative-importance monitoring across competing goals: SD-033e maintains a representation of relative importance across a set of active goals (parallel, not pairwise), enabling parallel-goal monitoring and flexible switching. Lesion analogue should reproduce the Mansouri 2015 over-focus + novel-rule-impairment phenotype.
claims_sample.subject: pfc.frontopolar_relative_importance_monitoring

claims_sample.title: Event-gated frontal write at goal-instantiation moments: when GoalState transitions from inactive to active, or when z_goal changes substantially, perform a high-bandwidth one-shot transfer of LatentStack content into SD-033a rule_state and SD-033b state_code, replacing the slow-EMA update for that tick. Mirrors Spellman et al. 2015 encoding-direction HPC->PFC dependence at goal-cue encoding.
claims_sample.subject: pfc.event_gated_frontal_write_at_goal_instantiation

claims_sample.title: pfc_context_bias_as_hippocampal_retrieval_gate -- PFC active goal/task representations send top-down bias signals that steer which hippocampal trajectory templates are retrieved or replayed; different PFC context states should produce different hippocampal retrieval subsets, enabling context-appropriate behavioral option selection; without this routing, the trajectory library is queried uniformly regardless of goal state.
claims_sample.subject: pfc.context_bias_hippocampal_retrieval_gate

claims_sample.title: dACC<->FPC reciprocal arbitration loop: the switch-to-alternative decision is not computed in one module but emerges from a comparison ACROSS two substrates -- the FPC-analog (SD-033e/MECH-264) carries the counterfactual value of the specific unchosen option, the dACC-analog (SD-032b) carries the environment search-value and expected-value-of-control, and slot-switching (SD-046) is gated by their relative comparison. Neither signal alone drives the switch; the loop does.
claims_sample.subject: pfc.dacc_fpc_reciprocal_arbitration_loop

claims_sample.title: z_harm_a enters action selection as a precision-weighted prediction error (harm_surprise_PE, SD-020) against an internal pain forward model (E2_harm_a), not as a raw magnitude. Upgrades SD-020 from provisional to prerequisite for SD-032b (dACC-analog).

claims_sample.title: Salience-network switch threshold: when the precision-weighted salience of any input to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) exceeds a threshold, the coordinator fires a whole-system mode switch rather than producing an incremental policy update.
claims_sample.subject: cingulate.switch_threshold

claims_sample.title: dACC-analog bias suppression against recency / monostrategy: the dACC module writes a counter-bias that resists repeating the last-rewarded trajectory when long-term value information demands exploration. claims_sample.subject: cingulate.dacc_bias_suppression

claims_sample.title: Mode-conditioned write gating: the operating-mode variable from the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a) determines which substrates can write to E3, episodic memory, policy updates, and autonomic coupling. Operating mode is implemented as a soft probability vector over {external_task, internal_planning, internal_replay, offline_consolidation}, not a one-hot categorical.

claims_sample.title: Asymmetric mode hysteresis in SalienceCoordinator: entering an operating mode uses a different threshold on the aggregate salience vector than exiting it, and the asymmetry is mode-specific. claims_sample.title: dACC conflict saturation: the dACC-analog (SD-032b) prediction-error / conflict signal caps and habituates under repeated identical outcomes; it does not grow unboundedly as conflict persists. claims_sample.title: Cingulate integration substrate: a network-level module with AIC, dACC/aMCC, pMCC, pACC, and PCC analog subdivisions bound by a salience-network coordinator. Primary output: operating-mode variable plus behavioural-adjustment-magnitude signal.

claims_sample.title: Salience-network coordinator: network-level module reading AIC-, dACC-, MCC-, PCC-analog subdivisions and outputting a discrete operating-mode variable (external_task / internal_replay / internal_planning / offline_consolidation) plus a mode-switch trigger.

claims_sample.title: dACC/aMCC-analog (adaptive control): module that reads z_harm_a precision-weighted prediction error, z_conflict, and control-demand signals; outputs behavioural-adjustment magnitude; writes to a learnable striatal-analog action-value target.

claims_sample.title: AIC-analog (interoceptive salience / urgency interrupt): module that integrates interoceptive baseline (drive/fatigue from SD-012) with affective-pain signal (z_harm_a), detects salient events, and triggers a network-switch signal to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

claims_sample.title: PCC-analog (attention partition / metastability): module coordinating transitions between external-task and internal (replay / planning / consolidation) modes; contributes a mode-stability parameter to the salience-network coordinator (SD-032a).

regions.notes: Freeze gate, override projections.

claims_sample.title: PAG-analog gates the freeze response: freeze commit when z_harm_a x duration exceeds threshold; exit requires z_harm_a to fall below an exit_threshold scaled by gaba_tone; failure of exit produces sustained immobility characteristic of stuporous catatonia.

claims_sample.title: LH-PAG override projection: a direct projection from LH (orexin and/or peri-LC GABA analog) to PAG modulates the GABAergic freeze gate (MECH-279) under metabolic demand. This produces the behavioural transition from freeze to active foraging under sustained hunger plus threat -- the foraging-under-predation phenotype the lit-pull surveys.

claims_sample.title: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, weak reading: a non-Bayesian rule-creator at the policy layer that proposes discriminative policy modes for the updaters (E3, training loop) to refine. V3 instantiation: a gated-policy architecture in which at least two policy heads share encoder features but receive different gating from a learned context discriminator (e.g., reef-context vs open-context heads). Tests the logical-necessity claim of MECH-309 within the existing V3 substrate without registering the heavier CandidateRule machinery (ARC-063, V4-deferred). Architectural slot, not yet implemented.
claims_sample.subject: policy.rule_apprehension_layer.weak_reading

claims_sample.title: Rule-apprehension architectural slot, strong reading: a distributed CandidateRule field with tolerance-gated availability, hippocampal-rollout-eligibility shaping, structured per-action evidence-trace records, and waking-vs-sleep refinement asymmetry. The biology-faithful form of the rule-apprehension layer, formalising the 2026-05-04 thought-intake on tolerance-gated rule apprehension (PNAS 10.1073/pnas.2508061123). Brought forward V4->V3 2026-05-18; V3-tractable design landed 2026-06-04 (docs/architecture/arc_063_candidate_rule_field.md). Only the social in-face (ARC-077/MECH-337) is V4-deferred (needs a caregiver-agent substrate absent in V3); the sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry is V3 (sleep rescoped to V3 2026-04-20; reuses the MECH-272/273/285 sleep cluster) and is a V3 follow-on within ARC-063, NOT V4. Persistent flag for governance: this slot is expected to be needed if ARC-062 (weak reading) fails or proves insufficient at scale, AND independently as the architectural commitment that supports moral-residue attribution to the rule-field, sleep-vs-waking refinement asymmetry, and clinically-realistic failure modes (trauma schemas, paranoid rule fields, depressive rollout constraint).
claims_sample.subject: policy.rule_apprehension_layer.strong_reading

claims_sample.title: policy_hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation (parent commitment for dynamic policy-primitive granularity in hippocampal rollout). Architectural commitment: the unit-of-policy that the rule-apprehension layer (ARC-062) and the diversity-generation layer (ARC-065) operate on is itself a dynamic representation, not a fixed primitive. The granularity rescales based on simulation outcomes -- decomposed into finer primitives when a chunk fails to ground at execution / prediction resolution (ARC-070), composed into a single primitive when a sequence has been repeatedly grounded with consistent outcomes (ARC-071). Without this commitment, ARC-007 hippocampal proposals are flat action sequences at fixed grain, and the rule layer must apprehend rules at whatever grain the proposer happens to emit, which may be too fine (combinatorial explosion in rollout) or too coarse (chunks fail to map onto the actual state). Cluster parent for ARC-070 (decomposition) + ARC-071 (composition); registers the architectural commitment that primitives are dynamic before any mechanism work.
claims_sample.subject: policy.hierarchy_dynamic_regranularisation

claims_sample.title: policy_decomposition_on_prediction_failure (zoom-in / re-segment imagined chains when chunks fail to ground at execution resolution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: when an imagined chunk's predicted outcome diverges from what its sub-elements would predict (or when MECH-269 V_s on the chunk's region drops), the chunk is broken into finer primitives in the rollout proposal stream. Trigger: simulation-side prediction failure. Direction: zoom in. Phenomenology anchor: 'I planned go-to-the-kitchen; turns out I need to plan the steps.'
claims_sample.subject: policy.decomposition_on_prediction_failure

claims_sample.title: policy_composition_via_repeated_grounding (zoom-out / chunk a sequence of primitives into a single atomic primitive after repeated successful execution). Child of ARC-069 dynamic-regranularisation parent commitment. Architectural commitment: sequences of policy primitives that have been repeatedly executed together with consistent outcomes are accumulated into a single primitive that the rule-apprehension and diversity-generation layers can treat atomically. Trigger: repetition count + outcome consistency (slow accumulator). Direction: zoom out. Phenomenology anchor: 'making coffee was once seventeen motor acts; after a thousand repetitions it is one unit.' Names the TRANSITION mechanism (planned -> habitual chunk) that MECH-163 dual systems presupposes but does not specify.
claims_sample.subject: policy.composition_via_repeated_grounding

claims_sample.title: Monomodal policy collapse is the equilibrium of a parametric-policy agent without a rule-apprehension layer. Bayesian update and gradient descent revise weights over a hypothesis space they do not invent; without a non-Bayesian rule-creator that proposes discriminative policy modes ('near-hazard -> reef regime; else -> forage regime'), the trainer collapses to the smoothest single regime good-enough across the whole state space. Monostrategy is therefore not a bug of training but the predicted output of an architecture in which only updaters exist and no apprehender does. Falsifiable by the weak-reading rule-apprehension experiment (ARC-062): a gated-policy architecture trained on the same substrate should break the collapse where standard E3 does not.
claims_sample.subject: policy.monomodal_collapse_as_equilibrium_without_rule_apprehender

claims_sample.title: rule_arbitration_multi_variable_multi_channel_dynamic_within_session. Parent claim for the multi-variable, multi-channel, dynamic-within-session arbitration that selects between competing rules / policy modes / action sources at the policy layer. Arbitration is governed by at least four distinct sub-mechanisms (MECH-312a/b/c/d), each falsifiable independently, with a candidate fifth (controllability/agency) deferred pending V3 substrate availability. Recommended combination rule: multiplicative gate (per-channel softmax of reliability * cost * agency * V_s * practice_maturity products) per Pull 3 R4 verdict; falsified against additive-logit baseline in V3-EXQ-543b/c. Reframed 2026-05-10 from earlier dual-channel-arbitration sketch following Pull 3 SYNTHESIS R5 SUB-MECH SPLIT recommendation (conf 0.78).
claims_sample.subject: policy.rule_arbitration_multi_variable_multi_channel_dynamic_within_session

claims_sample.title: uncertainty_reliability_weighting (Daw_2005_Lee_2014_dual_systems_arbitration_analog). Arbitration weight tracks the inverse-uncertainty / reliability of each candidate rule or policy mode; high-reliability sources receive higher arbitration weight. Biological substrate: model-based / model-free dual-systems arbitration (Daw et al. 2005 Nat Neurosci; Lee et al. 2014 Neuron). LOW divergence from existing literature; direct mapping. Sub-claim of MECH-312.
claims_sample.subject: policy.arbitration.uncertainty_reliability_weighting

claims_sample.title: practice_maturity_weighting (Smith_Graybiel_habit_takeover_analog). Arbitration weight tracks practice-maturity / habit-strength of each candidate rule or policy mode; well-practiced behaviour receives higher arbitration weight via a habit-takeover dynamic. Biological substrate: dorsolateral striatum habit consolidation (Smith & Graybiel 2013/2016); successor-representation maturation (Stachenfeld et al. 2017). LOW-MEDIUM divergence; partial mapping (the maturity dimension is well-anchored; the integration into a multi-channel arbitration layer is more REE-specific). Sub-claim of MECH-312.
claims_sample.subject: policy.arbitration.practice_maturity_weighting

claims_sample.title: affective_stream_modulation_of_arbitration_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated by affective stream load: when the SD-010 / SD-011 affective stream produces high load (high salience harm or affect), the arbitration layer routes more weight to rules associated with affect-laden context, suppressing arbitration weight on neutral-context rules. The REE-novel claim is the FUNCTIONAL CONSEQUENCE: dual-stream architecture (SD-010/SD-011) is well-anchored in Murray-Rudebeck 2018 and Pessoa-Adolphs 2010, but the modulation of rule-arbitration weights by affective-stream load is REE-specific (MEDIUM-HIGH divergence). Sub-claim of MECH-312.
claims_sample.subject: policy.arbitration.affective_stream_modulation_ree_novel

claims_sample.title: V_s_freshness_modulation_per_region_REE_novel. Arbitration weight is modulated per-region by V_s freshness (the per-region staleness scalar from MECH-269 / MECH-284 / MECH-287); rules associated with stale regions receive lower arbitration trust, regardless of their reliability or practice. HIGH divergence (REE-novel per-region scope + rule-trust function): Behrens 2007 ACC volatility and Bouton 2004 contextual renewal are nearest cousins, but per-region continuous scalar + arbitration-trust routing are REE-specific. Sub-claim of MECH-312.
claims_sample.subject: policy.arbitration.v_s_freshness_modulation_per_region_ree_novel

claims_sample.title: stochastic_noise_floor (max_entropy_policy_regularisation_LC_NE_tonic_analog). A floor-level stochastic action-selection noise that prevents complete deterministic collapse of the policy. Biological substrate: locus coeruleus tonic firing producing baseline action-selection variability (Aston-Jones & Cohen 2005 adaptive-gain model). Computational analog: max-entropy policy regularisation / SAC entropy bonus (Haarnoja et al. 2018). Distinct from MECH-260 dACC anti-recency: MECH-313 is a state-independent noise floor, while MECH-260 is a state-dependent recency penalty. Both can contribute to anti-monostrategy pressure but operate via different mechanisms; whether they collapse into a single substrate or are mutually load-bearing is open (Q-045).
claims_sample.subject: policy.stochastic_noise_floor_lc_ne_tonic_analog
